mission.title: Cold Start
mission.briefing: Shilovo, southern edge of Voronezh. Third winter after the Breach. A marauder gang has taken the gas station and the garage cooperative by the main road and is robbing every convoy that tries to reach the city. Take your column through the blocks, clear the outpost and burn their camp.

objectives.text: Clear the marauder outpost at the gas station
Destroy the marauder camp by the garages

do.text: Column, this is Command. Radio is dead past the ring road. Move east into the blocks and report.
Smoke over the gas station. Marauders. They've dug in with sandbags - take them out.
Outpost is clear. Fuel trucks are yours. Their main camp is in the garages south-east of the road.
Two more tanks from the depot are joining you.
Movement in the garages! Technicals coming from the field.
Camp is burning. The road to the city is open. Good work, column.
